title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Diego Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-oriented examples to help engineers onboard RAG + agents faster and to demonstrate tool-calling patterns with the Redwood API. What changed: 1) examples/agents/rag-templates: three agent templates (search+QA, multi-tool orchestration, and streaming Q&A) with README and minimal test harness; 2) examples/agents/tool-calling-quickstarts: two quickstarts showing tool registration, sandboxed tool wrappers, and best practices for retries/fallbacks; 3) docs/site: new Quickstarts > Agents, new RAG patterns guide, updated API references with tool-calling examples and a short troubleshooting section; 4) docs/snippets: added prompt templates and eval prompts used by the examples. Includes small runtime guidance notes (batching/kv-cache hints) to help customers tune cost/latency. Checklist: - [x] Examples implemented and smoke-tested locally - [x] Docs pages added and linked into sidebar - [x] CI passes for docs build and examples unit tests - [x] Reviewed and approved by Docs and Runtime teams Related: Linear ENG-2174 (RAG quickstarts), PM-432 (Docs quickstart roadmap). See linked PRs in redwood-examples for extended playbooks.
